definitions.explanation: The shape or form of a wave, whether physical (sound, light, water) or as displayed on instruments and screens. Used in scientific, technical, and audio contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{波形|はけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}する→表示する：26973_hyoujisuru⟧。
⟦{心電図|しんでんず}→心電図：28542_shindenzu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{波形|はけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There are no abnormalities in the ECG waveform.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}えば→使う：00473_tsukau⟧、⟦{録音|ろくおん}した→録音する：25388_rokuonsuru⟧⟦{音声|おんせい}→音声：04445_onsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{波形|はけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{細|こま}かく→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{編集|へんしゅう}できる→編集する：21991_henshuusuru⟧。
examples.english: With this software, you can edit the waveform of recorded audio in detail.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧ (wave) and ⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧ (shape). While the component kanji have native Japanese readings, this word uses the on'yomi readings. Commonly encountered in science, engineering, music production, and medical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {波形|はけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}する→表示する：26973_hyoujisuru⟧ — to display a waveform
- {波形|はけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}する→分析する：25338_bunsekisuru⟧ — to analyze a waveform
- {波形|はけい}⟦{編集|へんしゅう}→編集：04439_henshuu⟧ — waveform editing
- {正弦波|せいげんは}{波形|はけい} — sine waveform
- ⟦{心電図|しんでんず}→心電図：28542_shindenzu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{波形|はけい} — ECG waveform

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧ — wave; the physical wave itself, not its shape or graphical representation
- ⟦{波長|はちょう}→波長：27087_hachou⟧ — wavelength; the distance between wave peaks, a measurement rather than a shape
- ⟦{周波数|しゅうはすう}→周波数：25041_shuuhasuu⟧ — frequency; how often a wave cycles, not its visual form
